question: In MS-Excel 365 which of the following shortcut is used to copy the contents and format of the topmost cell of a selected range into the cells below?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + D.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ctrl + D shortcut in MS Excel **is used to fill it down.
 
• It copies the content and format of the topmost cell of a selected range into the cells below.
 
• This **shortcut is very useful when you want to quickly duplicate data into cells below in a column.**
 
• This feature can save time in manually entering the same data again and again.
 
• It's an essential tool in spreadsheet management and data entry **tasks in MS Excel.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Alt + D
 No standard function in MS Excel.
 
 

 Alt + C
 No standard function in MS Excel.
 
 

 Ctrl + C
 This shortcut is used to copy the selected cell or range.
